guidance.bestFor: Bold, italic and underline as borderless icon buttons that can all be on at once, none pressed at load

whenNotToUse.when: Formatting where only one option applies at a time, such as text alignment

guidance.bestFor: An outline pair of text options, All and Missed, with All picked and only one on at a time

whenNotToUse.when: A status filter with more than 2 states, such as active, completed and archived

guidance.bestFor: The sm and default heights stacked to compare, each an outline Top and Bottom pair with Top picked

whenNotToUse.when: The lg height, the largest of the 3 item sizes

guidance.bestFor: Day, Week and Month as separate outline items with Week picked on load
agentNotes: `spacing` 2 is already the `ToggleGroup` default, so this looks like any other outline set; pass 0 to join the items edge to edge

whenNotToUse.when: A finer time range that runs from hours to days in a smaller size

guidance.bestFor: Small outline items for 4 statuses, All, Active, Completed and Archived, with Active picked

whenNotToUse.when: A filter bar that adds fields, operators and values to build a query

guidance.bestFor: Bold, italic and underline stacked in an outlined column, icon only, with any mix on together
agentNotes: On the base twin `orientation` only stacks the items and never reaches Base UI, so focus still moves with the Left and Right arrows

whenNotToUse.when: The same formatting set laid out in a row with no borders

guidance.bestFor: Left, center, right and justify as borderless icon buttons where one alignment is on, left at load

whenNotToUse.when: Formatting marks such as bold and italic that can all be on together

name: c-toggle-group-8
title: Toggle group for view mode switching
label: View Mode
description: Toggle group for view mode switching

guidance.bestFor: Icon only outline choice of list, grid or kanban layout, with list picked and an aria label on each

whenNotToUse.when: Picking how many columns a grid shows rather than which view is open

guidance.bestFor: A borderless column of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Airplane Mode and Location with icon and label, any mix on, 2 at load
agentNotes: The base `ToggleGroup` keeps `orientation` for layout only, so Up and Down never move focus in this column; Left and Right do

whenNotToUse.when: Device settings such as airplane mode set as rows with a track beside each label

guidance.bestFor: Light, Dark and System choices with an icon and label each in outline, Light picked on load
agentNotes: `defaultValue` starts every visit on light; seed it from the saved theme so a returning dark mode user sees Dark picked

whenNotToUse.when: A theme choice tucked into an account popup that opens from the avatar

guidance.bestFor: Small outline items lettered S, M, L and XL for a short size scale, with M picked on load
agentNotes: Each `ToggleGroupItem` is named only by its letter, so screen readers announce S or XL; give each one a full size name

name: c-toggle-group-12
title: Toggle group for time range filter
label: Time Range
description: Toggle group for time range filter

guidance.bestFor: Small outline presets 1H, 6H, 24H, 7D, 30D and All in one row, with 24H picked on load

whenNotToUse.when: A custom span with a chosen start and end day, beyond fixed presets

guidance.bestFor: Email, SMS, Push and Slack with an icon and label each, any mix on together, Email and Push on at load

whenNotToUse.when: Channels ticked inside a form and posted along with its other fields

guidance.bestFor: Icon only outline picks for 1, 2, 3 or 4 columns, each named by its count, with 2 set at load
agentNotes: Each `value` is a string from 1 to 4; map it to a fixed column class, since Tailwind never generates one built at runtime

whenNotToUse.when: Switching between list, grid and kanban rather than a column count

guidance.bestFor: A small outline pair, Ascending and Descending, each led by an up or down arrow, Ascending on at load

whenNotToUse.when: Sorting that also picks the field to sort by from a list of columns

guidance.bestFor: A large outline Monthly and Yearly pair, the Yearly item carrying a filled Save 20% pill
agentNotes: The Save 20% pill is fixed text in a `span`; work the discount out from your real monthly and yearly prices

whenNotToUse.when: Plans compared as rows, each with a name, a price and a short pitch
